# Coach RODA | Ride Or Die America

> OUTGROW YESTERDAY. Solo across America since 2023 — 66,000+ miles, 1,250+ days on the road. One lesson daily.

Coach RODA (Sean Charles Downing) is a transformation mindset trainer riding solo across America since May 3, 2023. Transformation is the product. Endurance is the evidence. Cycling is the delivery vehicle. His framework is THE ROAD CODE: daily lessons from the road.

## Key facts
- Solo, unsupported bicycle journey across America since 2023
- 66,000+ total journey miles; 1,250+ journey days
- 23,000+ miles on the Aventon Aventure 2 e-bike (THE BEAST) with a Burley trailer (THE SHERPA)
- Route: currently riding toward Key West, then Alaska next
- Rides in support of Wounded Warrior Project, St. Jude's, and the American Breast Cancer Society

## Services
- Paid motivational speaking and corporate training
- Media and unscripted TV
- Paid brand partnerships (no affiliates, free-product-only, or discount-code deals)
